reassessment_reason: Refresh the FY2026-only rationale using the enacted FY2027 LARA provision. A possible customized listing remains a source inquiry candidate, without an established registry bulk contract.

candidate.price: Reasonable fee permitted; no registry extract quote established

access.bulk: FY2027 PA 21 of 2026, Article 10 section 252, permits customized nonconfidential listings for a reasonable fee. This does not specify a recurring business-entity extract.
access.api: No public registry API contract established by reviewed official documentation.
access.automation: Michigan.gov policies restrict automated access; a separate written agreement or applicable source-specific terms must establish the permitted route.

fields.summary: No current extract layout, identifier lifecycle, status dictionary or address-role dictionary established. Legacy COFS endpoints are retired.

active_status_semantics: Registry standing cannot by itself prove current business operation. Current extract status values and effective dates remain unresolved.
statewide_completeness: No acquired statewide release or complete registry denominator is established by this reassessment. Existing industry evidence remains separate.
address_zip: No extract address role or postal format is verified. Future processing must preserve ZIP5 and ZIP4 separately and must not treat registered-agent addresses as physical business sites.
automation_terms_fees: Commercial reuse is restricted by the Michigan.gov terms unless a written agreement or applicable agency terms allow it. No account, contract, payment or express acceptance was made; reading notices does not establish exemption from them.
redistribution: No new retention, geocoding, derived-publication or redistribution authorization established.
temporal_refresh: FY2027 enabling language is current to the reviewed fiscal period; listing cadence, as-of date, replacement/delta semantics, deletions and replay remain unpublished in the reviewed sources.

MiBusiness Registry Portal migration and permanently retired COFS routes.
